provenance.model: Three-link planar point-mass chain with one lumped linear shaft-flex coordinate
provenance.rigid_contract: Exact coordinate reduction phi2 = dphi2 = 0 with the same mass distribution
provenance.interpretation_boundary: This is a mechanism and sensitivity study, not a calibrated shaft, human-subject result, or validation of the archived Simscape model.

robustness_grid.attribution_boundary: Fractions are descriptive main-effect sums of squares for this balanced deterministic grid; the residual includes interactions and is not sampling uncertainty or a human causal share.
